newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Direct Capital sells PC Direct stake.
newsitem.headline: Direct Capital sells PC Direct stake.

text.p: Direct Capital Partners Ltd said on Friday it had sold a 25 percent stake in PC Direct for NZ$7.06 million.
Direct Capital executive Bill Kermode said Direct Capital's acceptance of the USOP offer had been driven by the decision of the majority shareholders to sell their stake in PC Direct.
The buyer was Blue Star Group, a unit of U.S. Office Products (USOP).
Direct Capital said that it, along with PC Direct majority shareholders Maurice Bryham and Sharon Hunter, had agreed in principle to sell, giving Blue Star full control.
The price paid to Direct Capital was set at NZ$$7.06 million, with payment being in USOP shares at a price based on recent USOP closing prices.
